question: How steep is the steepest part of Tamaha, Oklahoma?
What is the maximum slope in Benton City, Missouri?
sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-91.763827 39.131775, -91.767488 39.13181, -91.767385 39.136278, -91.767096 39.13633, -91.767069 39.137398, -91.762222 39.13728, -91.762445 39.131796, -91.763827 39.131775))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).max AS slope
FROM region_slope;
